claim: Over the campaign's 43 maps the number of foes met on each of the five difficulties, against the middle one, is 0.75, 0.81, 1, 1.19, 1.28 (types 201-250; 0.76 with type-18 spawners counted; by a map's median 0.76, 0.79, 1, 1.22, 1.29). A level that keeps nearly one population on every difficulty (Gravesend stood at 0.88, 0.90, 1, 1.01, 1.01 before difficulty.py; 0.73, 0.80, 1, 1.20, 1.28 after) has no real easy or hard.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_foes_per_difficulty.py over the 43 campaign maps (launch_skill bits; foes as projects/blood-city/level/difficulty.py _foe)
use: Author the middle difficulty, then thin free-standing ordinary foes for the two easier and add some beside them for the two harder, away from the start and from heights that see it.

checked.how: Recounted with knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_foes_per_difficulty.py over 43 campaign maps, launch_skill bits, foes as difficulty._foe (types 201-250 and 18): 2638/2832/3476/4150/4455, pooled 0.76, 0.81, 1, 1.19, 1.28; without type 18 0.75, 0.81, 1, 1.19, 1.28; by a map's median 0.76, 0.79, 1, 1.22, 1.29 either way. Gravesend's blood-city-current.MAP now 123/135/169/203/216 = 0.73, 0.80, 1, 1.20, 1.28 (the 0.88... was before difficulty.py).
